objective: Falsify or support a storage-neutral exact-gauge preconditioner for the dominant sensitive MLP mode by folding a fixed diagonal D into layer-59 up-projection CQ3 scales and topology-conditionally training down times D inverse.

scientific_hypothesis.exact_algebra: For positive diagonal D, down(silu(gate(x)) elementwise_multiply up(x)) equals (down D^-1)(silu(gate(x)) elementwise_multiply (D up)(x)).
scientific_hypothesis.quantization_hypothesis: Normalizing persistent down-projection column RMS before CQ3 packing reduces within-group dynamic-range competition. Up-row CQ3 quantization is positively homogeneous, so the inverse transformation can be folded into its existing row scales without changing codes, bytes, or runtime operations.
scientific_hypothesis.topology_hypothesis: Training down D^-1 against activations produced by the actual trained gate and gauged trained up payloads repairs the non-compositional reuse exposed by v69.
scientific_hypothesis.disconfirming_result: Any exactness or storage check fails, or the complete-MLP calibration NMSE improves by less than 20 percent over the authenticated v44 mixed-topology control.
scientific_hypothesis.novelty_status: unassessed; SmoothQuant, AWQ, cross-layer equalization, and SwiGLU gauge literature must be audited before any novelty claim

scope.selection_reason: largest v44 trained down-projection selected calibration NMSE, 0.21852178603165218, while its up projection remained substantially safer at 0.04141285384839074
scope.gate_payload: reuse exact v44 trained CQ3 bytes
scope.up_payload: reuse exact v44 trained CQ3 codes and multiply only its FP16 row-group scales by D
scope.down_payload: train CQ3 for down D inverse against the actual gauged candidate topology
scope.attention: exact BF16 cached layer replay used only to recover the frozen MLP inputs; no AFF3 is trained or evaluated

gauge.derivation: D_j = clamp(rms over rows of source down column j divided by the median positive column RMS, 0.25, 4.0)

training.method: activation-aware row-sharded hard-forward straight-through CQ3 training
training.teacher_inputs: D times exact cached down input
training.target_source: BF16 rounding of source down times D inverse

decision.if_pass: extend exact gauge training to a preregistered multilayer set, then materialize a whole-model candidate and restart quality gates from CUTE development screening
decision.if_fail: reject the fixed column-RMS diagonal gauge and retain v67 as the functional anchor

claim_boundary: Calibration-only layer-59 MLP gauge pilot. A pass cannot establish whole-model capability, perplexity, MATH, code, MMLU, throughput, energy, novelty, 100 tokens per second, or a scientific breakthrough.
